home.tagline: Navigate the heart of Bengal's grandest celebrations.
home.plan_with_group_desc: Create a shared tour plan, split into teams, explore together

poila_baisakh.name: Poila Baisakh
poila_baisakh.details: Marks the beginning of the Bengali calendar. Businesses open new ledgers known as Hal Khata.

pb1.name: Chaitra Sankranti
pb1.details: End of Bengali year, Charak Puja.

pb2.name: Poila Baisakh
pb2.details: First day of the Bengali new year.

jamai_sasthi.name: Jamai Sasthi
jamai_sasthi.details: Dedicated to sons-in-law, who are invited to their in-laws' homes for a feast and traditional blessings.

rath_yatra.name: Rath Yatra
rath_yatra.details: The grand chariot festival of Lord Jagannath, marked by massive processions.

jhulan_purnima.name: Jhulan Purnima
jhulan_purnima.details: Celebrates the romance of Radha and Krishna featuring decorated swings during the monsoon.

janmashtami.name: Janmashtami
janmashtami.details: Marked by fasting and midnight prayers.

vishwakarma.name: Vishwakarma Puja
vishwakarma.details: Industrial workers and drivers bless their tools and vehicles, and the sky fills with kites.

durga_puja.name: Durga Puja
durga_puja.details: The multi-day celebration of Goddess Durga’s victory over Mahishasura.

kojagari.name: Kojagari Lakshmi Puja
kojagari.shortDesc: Worship of the Goddess of Wealth
kojagari.details: Families draw intricate alpana and pray for prosperity.

kali_puja.name: Kali Puja
kali_puja.details: Worship of the fierce Goddess Kali alongside the lighting of diyas.

bhai_phonta.name: Bhai Phonta
bhai_phonta.details: Sisters apply a sandalwood dot on their brothers' foreheads praying for their long lives.

jagaddhatri.name: Jagaddhatri Puja
jagaddhatri.details: Famous for massive idols and light displays in Chandannagar.

poush_parbon.name: Poush Parbon
poush_parbon.details: Centers around date palm jaggery and traditional sweets (pithe and puli).

pp1.name: Makar Sankranti
pp1.details: Holy dip in the Ganges & Pithe Puli.

saraswati.name: Saraswati Puja
saraswati.details: Worship of the Goddess of Knowledge, often considered the Bengali Valentine's Day.

festivals_section.title: Baro Mase Tero Parbon
festivals_section.subtitle: Bengal is the land of 13 festivals in 12 months. Explore the rich cultural calendar of West Bengal.
